page_title: HEI 3-2 DAR | Heidenheim v Darmstadt 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' A cross into the box from Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is cleared.
90' Substitution. Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jan-Niklas Beste walks off.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' That's the end of the game for Tim Skarke, who is replaced by Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt).
88' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) replacing Emir Karic.
86' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 6:7.
84' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Emir Karic (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
78' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
76' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
74' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Tobias Kempe is replaced by Andreas Muller (Darmstadt).
74' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) replaces Jannik Muller.
74' The game has come to an end for Thomas Poppler Isherwood. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Matej Maglica (Darmstadt).
71' 3 - 2 Gooal! Jan-Niklas Beste takes over corner duties. Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the top right corner. 3:2.
70' Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.
69' 2 - 2 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
69' The ball is out of play and Heidenheim manage to earn a corner.
67' Substitution. Eren Dinkci leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
67' Here is a change. Lennard Maloney is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
63' It's a yellow card for Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim).
62' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
60' 1 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
57' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Omar Haktab Traore as he is replaced by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
55' Booking. Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) receives a caution from the referee.

52' 1 - 1 A good lofted pass from Fabian Holland finds Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:1.
51' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Darmstadt.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
42' Referee must have had a beep on his watch to confirm the ball crossed the goal line.

42' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Jan-Niklas Beste flights the free kick into the box, where Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) peels off his marker and heads straight into the top right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
41' The resulting set piece from Darmstadt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call.
33' Dangerous play by Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt). Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
29' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
25' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
20' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
18' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
15' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Heidenheim earn a corner.

12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
8' A cross from Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
6' Great touch by Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
4' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
2' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniel Schlager.
